search.label: Search for a product in your pantry
prioritize.title: Use these ingredients first?
prioritize.text: Mina reorganises upcoming meals you haven't cooked yet, favouring recipes that use them before they expire. Completed meals, manual picks, purchases and pantry stay as they are.
expiring.title: Expiring soon
expiring.button: Use them in your next meals
empty.title: Your pantry is empty
empty.text: When you confirm a shop, products show up here. You can also add what you already have.
filterEmpty.expiry: No expiry dates yet. Tap a product to add one.
staples.title: Basics at home
staples.empty: Salt, oil, spices and the like: mark them as at home to keep them off your list.
info.label: How the pantry works
info.text: Quantities come from confirmed shops and your corrections. Planned meals subtract nothing until you confirm you've cooked them.
shortage.a11y_one: {count} ingredient might not be enough. Tap to find out why
shortage.a11y_other: {count} ingredients might not be enough. Tap to find out why
shortage.explain: Your planned meals need more than your pantry shows ({list}). What's missing is already on your shopping list. If you have more at home, tap the product and fix the quantity.
resolved.a11y: Mina is happy: stock is sorted
resolved.title: All set now
resolved.text: Stock sorted: what you need is available or already on the list.
add.qtyError: Enter a quantity greater than zero.
add.toTasteNote: “To taste” ingredient: it will be marked as at home.
item.invalidUse: Enter how much you used, for example 100.
item.invalidDate: Invalid date: use the YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-11-20.
item.toTasteNote: “To taste” ingredients aren't weighed: we just need to know if you have them.
item.howMuch: How much do you really have?
item.expiryNote: Only if it's on the pack: Mina doesn't guess expiry dates.
budget.scopePartial: The budget covers only part of your food shopping.
budget.scopeSomeMeals: Estimate covers only the meals you plan in Mina, not your total food shopping.
budget.scopeAllMeals: Estimate based on the meals planned in Mina.
